/wiki/Usain_Bolt: Usain St Leo Bolt is a Jamaican retired sprinter, widely considered to be the greatest sprinter of all time. He was coached by Glen Mills.
/wiki/Yohan_Blake: Yohan Blake is a Jamaican sprinter. He trains at the Racers Track Club in Kingston, coached by Glen Mills.
/wiki/Justin_Gatlin: Justin Gatlin is an American sprinter born in Brooklyn, New York.
/wiki/Tyson_Gay: Tyson Gay is an American former sprinter born in Lexington, Kentucky.
